title: [DOC2-13] Universal-IdP profile omits the sidecar's admission-key host role
description: Review finding DOC2-13: Universal-IdP profile omits the sidecar's admission-key host role (lens DOC2). Location: profiles/universal-idp-did.md:22, :686-697. Fix: The profile "extends the DID Sidecar's `IdentityProvider` interface" and "Depends On ... O365 DID Spec", so the O365 §6.7 duties are arguably inherited. That lowers the severity. The concrete defect is the reverse-proxy list, which claims to expose "only the public endpoints" and leaves out `/v1/admission-key/*` and `/v1/auth` (O365:602-606). Under that topology, DMs and self-group admission fail. Add those paths to the proxy list, and add one sentence at :22 deferring to O365 §6.7. Full text: notes/review2/DOC2-verified.md and notes/review2/DOC2.md.
